description: Mark an old version of your model as replaced by a newer one. The old id keeps working and its commons dedication (if any) stands — only the listing moves on to the successor. Both models must be yours. It also records a supersededBy edge (old → new), so sim_edges(old) and sim_neighbors(old, "supersededBy") show that the supersession happened. Re-pointing an old model to a different successor keeps the earlier edge too, and these edges carry no timestamp, so their order says nothing about which came last: the current successor is the `current` this tool returns (the model's own supersededBy record), not the edge list.
name: sim_supersede_model
